items.description: Floor cleaning, washing machine connection check, skirting board replacement (utility room and hallway)
items.rationale: The washing machine hose leak is escape of water under 2.4.2(a). Cleaning of affected floors is covered under 7.1.7(h), the source check under 7.1.7(e), and the skirting boards are building components under 4.2.2. The estimate is a moderate market price for the combined flat rate.

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of utility room and hallway floor incl. drying unit and labour
items.rationale: Moisture measurement, drying and equipment hire are expressly part of necessary repair costs under 7.1.7(b) and (e). Both affected rooms were wetted. The estimate is an ordinary market price for drying two small rooms.

items.description: Assessment and drying of framed decorative print
items.rationale: The print is movable household contents, which is not insured under 4.3(d). The 5.2.6 cost head applies only to items of particular value, such as works of art. A mass-produced poster print in a pine frame does not qualify, so t is 0.
